about.title: About Dewe Instruments
about.subtitle: Measuring what matters in industrial processes since 2008.
about.story: Founded in Bengbu, Anhui in 2008, Anhui Dewe Instrument Co., Ltd. designs and manufactures process measurement instruments for the world's most demanding industries. From our first pressure transmitter to today's full range of pressure, flow, temperature and level instruments, we have shipped to plants in over 40 countries.
about.mission: Make reliable, certified process measurement accessible to every industrial operation — without the premium import price tag.
